summary: Every encoded condition traces to the page and no invented content was found; the most consequential problem is dropped mpox exposure criteria (probable/confirmed case, 21 days before onset). Coverage gaps outside the rules: no bubo diagnosis (groin node hot and tender), no 'refer same week' priority for generalised/unwell/rapidly enlarging nodes or thyroid mass, and no TB-aspiration or cancer-screening features. Minor: cough impulse is a proxy for 'bigger when standing/coughing/passing stool', hidradenitis site/pain linkage is loose, and incarcerated and strangulated rules are identical.
